trigger.symptom: all 15 tasks of launch 01M0NSM5RTT6NQYHGG0HJWVD6E failed ~45s after submit with omegaconf ConfigAttributeError: Key 'shuffle' is not in struct / hydra ConfigCompositionException: Could not override 'data.timing_features.shuffle'
trigger.cause: the shuffle/shuffle_seed keys were declared only in code/config/data/mice_snapshot.yaml, but study-07 sweeps compose data=mice_snapshot_scaling. Each data config in this repo carries its OWN FULL COPY of the timing_features block and does not inherit from a shared base, so a new key must be declared in every config a sweep might compose. Extends the two-repo config rule: not just 'both repos' but 'every data config on the composed path'. Fixed in ae8707d (mice_snapshot, mice_snapshot_scaling, mice_snapshot_smallpool). The failure is loud and fast (composition error at startup), not silent.
